title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service — Delivery Speed and Settlement Terms Sheet
content:
Delivery and settlement terms of the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service are the same on every tier. Instant payouts go to Paystride Visa Payroll Cards and to external debit cards; bank account payouts go by same-day ACH.

| Term | Starter | Core | Growth | Pro | Scale | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Same-day ACH cutoff, Eastern Time (HH:MM) | 14:00 | 14:00 | 14:00 | 14:00 | 14:00 | 14:00 |
| Largest same-day ACH entry accepted by the ACH network (USD) | 1000000 | 1000000 | 1000000 | 1000000 | 1000000 | 1000000 |
| Instant disbursements every day of the year | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Instant external delivery time before the fee is credited as late (minutes) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Fee of a late instant disbursement credited | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Push-to-card networks for external debit cards | Visa Direct; Mastercard Send | Visa Direct; Mastercard Send | Visa Direct; Mastercard Send | Visa Direct; Mastercard Send | Visa Direct; Mastercard Send | Visa Direct; Mastercard Send |
| Same-day ACH requested on a non-business day settles the next business day | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

The tiers are Paystride Instant Pay Starter, Core, Growth, Pro, Scale and Enterprise.

## Terms defined

- **Same-day ACH cutoff** — the Eastern Time after which a same-day ACH disbursement settles the next business day (HH:MM).
- **Largest same-day ACH entry** — the largest same-day ACH entry accepted by the ACH network (USD).
- **Instant every day** — whether instant disbursements run every day of the year.
- **Instant external delivery time** — the minutes within which an instant external disbursement must be delivered before its fee is credited as late.
- **Late fee credit** — whether the fee of a late instant disbursement is credited.
- **Push-to-card networks** — the networks used for external debit cards.
- **Weekend rollover** — whether same-day ACH requested on a non-business day settles the next business day.

## Illustrations (hypothetical requests)

- A same-day ACH payout requested at 13:59 Eastern Time on a business day is before the 14:00 cutoff; one requested at 14:01 is after it and settles the next business day.
- An instant external payout confirmed as delivered 30 minutes after submission is within the 30-minute figure; one delivered after 31 minutes exceeds it.
